scope: X-ray-bright early-type galaxies with hydrostatic X-ray mass determinations. ACQUISITION ONLY - no analysis, no residuals, no acceleration ratios, no model comparison performed.

sources_acquired.reference: Babyk I.V., McNamara B.R., Nulsen P.E.J., Hogan M.T., Vantyghem A.N., Russell H.R., Pulido F.A., Edge A.C. 2018, ApJ 857, 32, 'X-ray Scaling Relations of Early-type Galaxies'
sources_acquired.object_class: early-type galaxies: E, S0/SA0/SAB0, plus BCGs and cD galaxies; morphological type flagged per object
sources_acquired.radius_definition: single radius per object: r = 5 r_e, five optical half-light radii; the value in kpc is tabulated per object as r_5re with its error
sources_acquired.total_mass_method: isothermal beta-model fit to the Chandra X-ray surface brightness combined with the single-temperature spectral fit, inserted into the hydrostatic-equilibrium equation. NOT an NFW fit, NOT a lensing or light-tied parametric model.
caveats: Where the X-ray surface-brightness profile does not reach 5 r_e the authors extrapolated the mass profiles to 5 r_e using the slope of the last 20 points in log-log space.
M_tot carries two separate errors: statistical then systematic.
Metallicity entries without an error were frozen at 0.5 Zsun.

The Table 1 coordinate columns are headed '(J2000)' but the paper text states the coordinates were taken as galactic coordinates from SIMBAD; treat the RA/DEC columns as suspect and re-resolve positions from the object name if needed.
L_X is the 0.5-2.0 keV band luminosity, not bolometric.

sources_acquired.reference: Nagino R., Matsushita K. 2009, A&A 501, 157, 'Gravitational potential and X-ray luminosities of early-type galaxies observed with XMM-Newton and Chandra'
sources_acquired.radius_definition: three radii per object: r < 0.5 r_e, r < 3 r_e, r < 6 r_e. r_e is tabulated in arcmin; the kpc equivalents are reconstructed here from the adopted distance D.
sources_acquired.total_mass_method: non-parametric hydrostatic: M(R) = -kT(R)R/(G mu m_p) (dln n/dln R + dln T/dln R) evaluated on the deprojected ISM temperature and density profiles. NOT an NFW fit; NFW appears in the introduction only as literature context.
does_not_provide: gas mass M_gas(<r) - NOT TABULATED ANYWHERE IN THIS PAPER
tabulated L_K (used by the authors from 2MASS but not printed, so M/L_K cannot be inverted to a mass from this table alone)
tabulated kT per object (temperature profiles are plotted, not tabulated)
caveats: Columns labelled RECONSTRUCTED are computed here from the tabulated columns (unit conversion and M/L x L product); they are not values printed in the paper. The raw tabulated M/L and log L_B columns are retained alongside.
6 r_e columns are empty for NGC1549, NGC4365, NGC4526 and NGC4552 (profile did not reach 6 r_e).
For NGC1549, NGC4477 and NGC5322 the mass inside 0.5 r_e rests on XMM-Newton data only.

sources_examined_and_rejected.reason_rejected: RULE 2 VIOLATION: the only tabulated total masses are M_vir, r_vir and concentration c from a parametric 'NFW+stars' fit. The non-parametric mass profile points appear only as a figure, not as a table.

sources_examined_and_rejected.reference: Babyk et al. 2018, ApJ 862, 39, 'A Universal Entropy Profile for the Hot Atmospheres of Galaxies and Clusters within R2500'
sources_examined_and_rejected.reason_rejected: Contains no tabulated gas mass or total mass. Table 1 is observation metadata for 40 low-mass systems; the remaining tables are broken-power-law entropy fit coefficients. M2500 is plotted but never tabulated.

sources_examined_and_rejected.reference: Babyk et al. 2019, ApJ 887, 149, 'Origins of Molecular Clouds in Early-type Galaxies'
sources_examined_and_rejected.reason_rejected: The 40-galaxy temperature, density, cooling-time, gas-mass and total-mass profiles are PLOTTED only; no radial profile table exists in the LaTeX source. Tables give observation metadata, kT, molecular gas mass and 1.4 GHz flux.

vizier_probe_results.method: https://vizier.cfa.harvard.edu/viz-bin/ReadMe/<ID> with curl -sL (the CfA mirror answers https with a 302 to http, so redirects MUST be followed or every probe looks like a failure)

vizier_probe_results.J/ApJ/862/39: ReadMe is not found - NO CATALOGUE
vizier_probe_results.J/ApJ/646/899: ReadMe is not found - NO CATALOGUE
vizier_probe_results.J/A+A/501/157: ReadMe is not found - NO CATALOGUE
vizier_probe_results.J/ApJ/669/158: ReadMe is not found - NO CATALOGUE
vizier_probe_results.J/A+A/601/A95: PRESENT but is a DIFFERENT PAPER: Calabro+ 2017, 'Star-forming dwarfs at intermediate-z in VUDS'. It is NOT O'Sullivan CLoGS.
vizier_probe_results.J/ApJS/174/117: PRESENT: Maughan+ 2008, 115 Chandra clusters. NOT acquired - it is Priority 3, to be used only if Priorities 1 and 2 both failed, and Priority 1 succeeded.
vizier_probe_results.VII/233: PRESENT: 2MASS All-Sky Extended Source Catalog (XSC); table VII/233/xsc.
vizier_probe_results.VII/240: PRESENT but is a DIFFERENT catalogue: the Millennium Galaxy Catalogue (Liske+ 2003). It is NOT the 2MASS Large Galaxy Atlas.
vizier_probe_results.J/AJ/125/525: ABSENT - '#INFO<TAB>Error=Table or Catalog not found'. The 2MASS Large Galaxy Atlas is not available in VizieR under this identifier.
vizier_probe_results.J/MNRAS/413/813: PRESENT: ATLAS-3D (Cappellari+ 2011). The table is named 'atlas3d' (871 rows), NOT 'table3'/'table4' as the ReadMe JSON's .dat filenames suggest.
vizier_probe_results._TRAP_error_marker: The ASU error marker is '#INFO' + TAB + 'Error='. Testing for '#INFO Error=' with a SPACE never matches and silently turns a missing catalogue into an apparent success. Test for '	Error='.
vizier_probe_results._TRAP_readme_endpoint: The /ReadMe/<ID> JSON endpoint answers 'ReadMe is not found' for table-level IDs such as 'VII/233/xsc' that DO exist and return data via asu-tsv. It is not authoritative for existence; confirm with an asu-tsv query.

ancillary_photometry.purpose: Near-infrared K_s TOTAL apparent magnitudes for the 94 Babyk+2018 ETGs, acquired so that a stellar mass can be formed LATER. NO mass-to-light ratio has been applied and NO stellar mass has been computed here.

primary_photometry.meaning: total extrapolated Ks magnitude, from the fit to the radial profile out to r.ext

cross_check_only.note: PHOTOMETRY ONLY. No dynamical mass-to-light ratio or any other dynamical quantity was read from this catalogue.

ancillary_photometry.adjudication_rule: The 2MASS XSC cone match is accepted only when its K.ext agrees to within 0.5 mag with at least one independent NAME-based lookup (HyperLeda by name, or a 2MRS entry). This is what certifies the cross-identification; positional proximity alone does not. Where the XSC match is contradicted or absent, the fallback actually used is recorded per object in the flags column.
caveats: 2MASS XSC K.ext and HyperLeda kt are NOT extinction corrected; 2MRS Ktmag IS. The per-object column Ks_extinction_corrected records which applies.

The ATLAS-3D cross-check is a CONSISTENCY check, not an independent one: ATLAS-3D KMAG is itself built on 2MASS photometry, which is why the scatter is only 0.008 mag. It confirms the extraction and the cross-identification, not the underlying photometric scale.

Three objects matched at >5 arcsec (NGC741 35.0", NGC6098 36.2", NGC1265 43.5") because the SIMBAD position is imprecise or the object is absent from the XSC. NGC741 and NGC6098 were corroborated by an independent name-based HyperLeda lookup and kept; NGC1265's XSC match was rejected and replaced.
ATLAS-3D photometry only was used; no dynamical mass-to-light ratio or other dynamical quantity was read from that catalogue.
